_comment: OPEN search, -150/+500 Da. The PRIMARY metric window.
variable_mods is EMPTY and max_variable_mods 0 on purpose: every mass shift must land in the
open (delta-mass) dimension rather than being absorbed by an enumerated modification, or the
delta-mass histogram -- the whole diagnostic -- is contaminated by things the search already
WINDOW LIMIT, stated because it is a design parameter of the experiment, not an oversight:
a charge error gives dM = (z'-z)(m/z - 1.00728). At +-500 Da this window shows the slope +-1
rays (3->2 and 2->3, |dM| ~ m/z) but CANNOT show slope +-2 (4->2, |dM| ~ 2*m/z ~ 1000-2800 Da).
The 4->2 positive control therefore needs sage_open_wide.json.
